houses.name: River's Iron Wall
houses.line: Hold the fords, brothers. Let the river run red with their blood, not ours. Stand firm until the mist clears.

houses.name: Kite General, Skyward Bound
houses.line: Ride the wind, hold the fords, claim victory!

houses.name: The Iron Bloom
houses.line: Roots grip stone—hold the fords until the last watch ends.

houses.name: General of House TIGER
houses.line: Stand firm, brothers! Hold the fords, protect our camp, and let no enemy standard pass our lines!
